basic_info.description: This contemporary 3/3 two-level condo is filled with charm and boasts breathtaking panoramic city views! The heart of the home is on the main level-an oversized living and dining area bathed in natural light, and featuring a fireplace and direct access to a sunny deck-ideal for relaxing or dining while enjoying breathtaking city views and sunrises. The bright and airy kitchen offers ample counter space and newer appliances. The primary ensuite bedroom, a second bedroom, another full bathroom, and a stacked laundry closet complete this level. Head downstairs to the open-layout lower level, currently set up as the third bedroom but which could also be a family room or office. This flexible space includes an updated full bathroom. Head outside to the serene garden patio and shared yard. This peaceful oasis features fruit trees and flowering plants. A paved seating area provides the perfect spot for reading a book and outdoor lounging. The shared garage offers convenient interior access. Located in a Walker's Paradise (92 Walk Score), this home is just moments from the J Church line, as well as the popular shops and restaurants of 24th Street. Enjoy the best of Liberty Hill and Noe Valley. Stunning views and modern comfort await!
